body_markdown:
[All Announcements](https://feedback.heypocket.com/announcements) 1 Apr, 2026


Maclean here, heads up we have a short maintenance period coming up to improve Pocket.


Saturday, April 4 from 8:00 PM to 9:00 PM PDT (11:00 PM to 12:00 AM EDT)


During this time:


- Some app features might be unavailable (e.g., Transcription, Ask Pocket)
- You can still record offline and sync later
- New summaries will be paused
- Your data is safe as always


Thanks for your patience!
